proposedEdit.summary: Providers and deployers take measures to support the development of AI literacy among staff and others operating AI on their behalf, taking account of their background, use context and affected people. This duty does not require guaranteeing any individual a particular level of literacy.

proposals.rightsScope: IMDA terms read in rendered browser: clauses6–9 restrict reuse and clauses23–25 restrict deep linking, with overlapping wording. Retain this as private factual research; resolve the proposed public use through permission or a clearly authorised alternative primary publication. No report text, figures, logo or site design may be copied.
